title: Gold harness stack mh-dev-02
description: First isolate any legacy Astra worker so only the canonical worker may write control/results. Using only normal user-space and GitHub-controlled execution, install/complete DeepSeek Harness (dsh) and stagewise where headless operation is supported. Add illegal-xd/delx-memory-bun as the local-first MCP persistent-memory component for DSH/Astra, using documented Bun runtime and loopback HTTP/stdio mode. Do not use sudo, do not modify canonical Astra transport, and do not change production services. Validate versions/help, build/install status, delx-memory doctor/health, DSH local startup readiness, and connectivity to existing Ollama/OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Treat illegal-xd/WebTool-DeepSeek as client-side Chrome extension only: document as optional UI integration, do not install a browser extension on the server. Then execute canonical bounded Astra coding qualification and publish fresh evidence to control/results/mh-dev-02.json via GitHub.
